recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed; future source maintenance for workflow-relatedArtifact should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack repository.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Observation change request asking to allow http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/workflow-relatedArtifact on Observation.component so component-level citations and knowledge artifacts do not require custom extensions.
initial_application: Jira records application as git c0bd9e4. That commit is in HL7/fhir-extensions and adds Observation.component to input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-workflow-relatedArtifact.xml; the current FHIR core checkout had already removed extension definitions from R5 source in dd468d4f17.
additional_context: Current core source only retains the workflow-relatedArtifact canonical OID and does not contain the extension StructureDefinition. The FHIR Extension Pack source currently lists ConceptMap, DiagnosticReport, Observation, and Observation.component contexts. FHIR-25170 is related Genomics Reporting background that points to FHIR-39113 as the O&O/R5 fix, but it is outside the core reconciliation scope.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The audit commit records that the authoritative source is external to the FHIR core checkout and already contains the requested component context.
